cd.title: Despacito
cd.situation: DJ K-Bit's remix of 'Despacito' came out yesterday and is 'too slow for the charts', but everyone at this bus stop has a phone in their hand.
cd.today: DJ K-Bit's 'Despacito' remix went gold as the ringtone of 2017. The shop sells the CD with a free phone sticker.

actions.label: AirDropped DJ K-Bit's remix to your phone
actions.line: K-Bit holds his phone up to yours. 'Accept it... despacito.' Ping. His 'Despacito' remix is now your ringtone.

actions.label: let it ring at the busiest bus stop in town
actions.line: Your phone goes off. The whole queue turns round. 'Wait, what IS this? Somebody Shazam it!'
actions.lockedLine: You wait at the bus stop. Your phone only has the default ringtone, and nobody even looks up.

offline.headline: The Bus Queue That Discovered DJ K-Bit
offline.article: In January 2017 a whole bus queue heard DJ K-Bit's 'Despacito' remix ring out of one phone and reached for Shazam. By summer it was the most streamed song in the country, and its gold disc still hangs in Hollow Records.
